ignorePatterns.comment: linuxfoundation.org/trademark-usage intermittently returns 404 to CI runners (bot-blocking); the page is live from normal clients. main hits the same flake. See #14366.

comment_aliveStatusCodes: 429/500/502/503/504 added because github.com links intermittently return these from CI runners (rate-limiting on 429, transient 5xx otherwise), not because the link is actually dead; see #14366. retryOn429 handles most 429s but can be exhausted during a large scan.
